text: dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof 是一个离线 DSH 工具，用于核验显式提供的紧急访问会话结算证据。它检查会话时间线、动作与资源 allowlist、主体绑定、已声明授权的撤销回执，以及 closure 的残留授权数量和证据新鲜度。inspect 返回摘要；verify 生成并回读校验内容寻址报告。它不连接在线身份服务，运行要求 Node.js 22 或更新版本。

dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof is an offline DSH tool for checking supplied emergency session evidence. It checks chronology, allowlists, bindings, grant revocations, and closure freshness. Inspect summarizes; verify writes and checks a content-addressed report. Requires Node.js 22+.
想离线检查一份紧急访问会话的结算证据是否完整。
帮我核对 break-glass 会话里的操作和资源是否都在允许范围内。
I need to verify that a supplied emergency access session was closed within its allowed time.
dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof 的功能「会话结算核验」：检查 manifest 的时间线、allowlist、绑定、授权撤销和 closure 新鲜度，并返回结果。通过 DSH verify 工具触发。

dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof README · dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof：**Maintainer / Author：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen) · [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)**

Offline, deterministic evidence for one narrow question: **does the supplied emergency-access session close within its declared lifetime, contain only allowlisted action/resource receipts, and revoke every declared grant before a fresh closure observation?**

dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof README · dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof：The same headless core is exposed as a DSH bundle, standalone MCP stdio server, JavaScript API and CLI. Reports are redacted, content-addressed and verified after writing.

dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof README · Complementary boundary：Microsoft recommends limiting emergency access to true break-glass scenarios, monitoring every use, and using it only for the necessary amount of time. This plugin verifies a supplied settlement; it is not an identity provider or privileged-access manager.

dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof README · Complementary boundary：- `dsh-principal-binding-proof` verifies which principal an evidence chain binds.
- `dsh-policy-waiver-proof` verifies why a policy exception is allowed.
- `dsh-audit-bundle` packages audit evidence.
- This plugin checks activation, bounded allowlisted actions, termination, declared grant revocation and fresh closure as one supplied session.

dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof README · Complementary boundary：It never grants, activates, approves or revokes access; authenticates receipts; queries live identity infrastructure; or proves there were no undeclared actions or grants. `residualGrantCount: 0` is only a claim in the provided closure.

dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof README · Use：```bash
npm test
npm run check
node bin/dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof.mjs inspect examples/settled.json
node bin/dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof.mjs verify examples/settled.json

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:dongsheng123132/dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof#<commit>
```

dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof README · Use：DSH tools are `dsh_break_glass_inspect` and `dsh_break_glass_verify`. MCP tools are `break_glass_inspect` and `break_glass_verify`.

See [`examples/settled.json`](examples/settled.json). Only public IDs, timestamps, counts and SHA-256 bindings belong in a manifest. Never put credentials, account names, tokens, raw audit logs or business text in it.

dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof README · Use：References: [Microsoft Entra emergency access accounts](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/security-emergency-access), [security operations for privileged accounts](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/architecture/security-operations-privileged-accounts), [secure access practices](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/security-planning).

dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof README · dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof：作者 / 维护者：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen)· [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)

这是一个离线、确定性的 DSH 证据层，只回答一个窄问题：**显式提供的紧急访问会话，是否在声明寿命内闭合，只包含 allowlist 中的动作/资源回执，并在新鲜的 closure 观察前撤销全部已声明授权？**

同一个无界面核心同时提供 DSH bundle、独立 MCP stdio、JavaScript API 和 CLI；报告脱敏、内容寻址，并在写后回读。

dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof README · 互补边界：Microsoft 建议 break-glass 只用于真正的紧急情况、每次使用都要监控，并把使用时间限制到绝对必要范围。本插件只核验 supplied settlement，不是身份系统或 PAM。

- `dsh-principal-binding-proof` 证明证据链绑定哪个主体；
- `dsh-policy-waiver-proof` 证明为何允许例外；
- `dsh-audit-bundle` 打包审计证据；
- 本插件把激活、限时 allowlisted 动作、终止、已声明授权撤销和新鲜 closure 合成一次会话结算。

它不会授予、激活、审批或撤销权限，不认证回执、不查询线上身份系统，也不证明没有未声明动作或授权。`residualGrantCount: 0` 只表示提供的 closure 声明。

dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof README · 核验项：- request、activation、termination、expiry、closure 时序；
- 会话与到期时长上限；
- 活跃区间内连续、有序的动作回执；
- 显式 action/resource allowlist；
- actions、grants、closure 的同一 session/principal binding；
- 每个已声明 grant 都有非零 revocation receipt 与合法撤销时序；
- 声明的残留授权数量、观察者多样性、证据新鲜度；
- 拒绝秘密/raw 字段、workspace 限界、symlink 防护、内容寻址回读。

```bash
npm test
npm run check
node bin/dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof.mjs verify examples/settled.json
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:dongsheng123132/dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof#<commit>

dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof README · 核验项：DSH 工具是 `dsh_break_glass_inspect`、`dsh_break_glass_verify`；MCP 工具是 `break_glass_inspect`、`break_glass_verify`。完整 manifest 见 [`examples/settled.json`](examples/settled.json)。禁止放账户名、密钥、token、原始审计日志或业务正文。

规范来源：[Microsoft Entra emergency access](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/security-emergency-access)、[privileged account security operations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/architecture/security-operations-privileged-accounts)。
